result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for the vendor’s processing of Client data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after the term and amending the survival provision to include Section 31 go beyond the playbook and are not necessary to implement it. The language otherwise preserves unrelated terms and is professionally drafted.
